title: Myeolchi Bokkeum Stir-Fried Anchovies
shortDescription: Small dried anchovies are toasted until crisp, then coated lightly with a glossy soy and rice-syrup glaze plus sesame.
culturalContext: Myeolchi bokkeum is a Korean stir-fried dried-anchovy banchan. Anchovy size, sweetness, nuts, chile, and texture vary; this draft is nut-free and uses very small anchovies.
author: {{LEGAL_NAME}}
equipment: Clean sheet pan or wide plate

allergenNotes: fish; verify package for other allergens

instructions.heading: Check the package
instructions.action: Read the dried-anchovy label for fish and any facility or added-ingredient allergens; discard damaged, moldy, rancid, or pest-affected product.
instructions.visualOrTactileCue: Anchovies smell clean and savory, not rancid.
instructions.safetyNote: The package label controls allergen and storage guidance.

instructions.heading: Sift
instructions.action: Shake anchovies in a fine-mesh sieve to remove loose powder.
instructions.safetyNote: Avoid inhaling seafood dust and clean the area afterward.

instructions.heading: Toast dry
instructions.action: Toast anchovies in a dry skillet over medium heat, stirring, until crisp and fragrant; transfer out.
instructions.visualOrTactileCue: Anchovies are dry and crisp without scorching.
instructions.safetyNote: Do not taste if the product has a rancid or abnormal odor.

instructions.heading: Build the glaze
instructions.action: Add oil, soy sauce, rice syrup, and water to the skillet and simmer briefly.
instructions.visualOrTactileCue: The glaze bubbles and begins to thicken.
instructions.safetyNote: Hot syrup can cause burns; avoid splashing.

instructions.heading: Coat briefly
instructions.action: Return anchovies and toss only until thinly coated; remove from heat and add sesame oil and seeds.
instructions.visualOrTactileCue: Anchovies are glossy but remain separate.
instructions.safetyNote: Do not over-reduce the hot sugar glaze.

instructions.heading: Cool and store
instructions.action: Spread on a clean plate for 5 minutes, then serve or transfer to a clean container.
instructions.visualOrTactileCue: The glaze is set and anchovies remain crisp.
instructions.safetyNote: Follow the package storage direction; refrigerate the cooked dish within 2 hours unless a qualified reviewer approves otherwise.

grillSetup: Not applicable; this banchan is stir-fried on the stovetop.
targetInternalTemperature: Use a commercially dried ready-to-cook anchovy product and follow any package heating direction; toast until hot, crisp, and fragrant.
visualDonenessCues: Glaze coats without a sticky pool
foodSafetyNotes: Verify fish and all other allergens on the exact package.
Discard rancid, moldy, damaged, or pest-affected dried seafood.
Follow the stricter package storage and heating directions.

allergens.crossContactWarning: Contains fish, soy, wheat/gluten, and sesame; the dried-anchovy package may declare additional cross-contact.

substitutions: Use certified gluten-free tamari only after verifying every label.
Do not add nuts without a new allergen and cross-contact review.
ingredientSourcing: Choose small dried anchovies intended for bokkeum in a sealed, dated package from a high-turnover market.
makeAhead: Prepare up to 3 days ahead pending package and food-safety review.
storage: Follow the package direction; absent a stricter instruction, refrigerate in a covered container within 2 hours and use within 4 days pending review.
reheating: Serve cool or briefly refresh in a dry skillet; do not repeatedly reheat.
leftovers: Use only properly stored leftovers within the approved package or review window.
servingSuggestions: Serve in small portions with rice and other banchan.

faq.question: Do I need to remove heads and guts?
faq.answer: Very small anchovies are often used whole, but package size and test cooking control.

faq.question: Can I add peanuts?
faq.answer: Not in this draft; adding nuts requires a new allergen review.
